licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (vo un po without apostrophes; dell' altro as two words).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 219–223, bars 1–78 of No. 20
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 219–221 and 222–223), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. The thirty-second and sixteenth groups in the voices were settled by counting beams. Bar 1 is a one-eighth upbeat, set as 1/8; bars 75–78 are for the piano alone. Playback tempo ♩ = 60, estimated (no timing was found); Mozart gives the word Andante only.
